transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: I made a paper copy. Radios get jammed. Ink still travels in a boat. It's in the harbour master's safe, and she doesn't like the Marshal either.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: The harbour stores are gone. The harbour master has the copy on a courier launch. The eastern wing has the harbour mouth sealed.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Everything we have is on that boat. The archive, the signatures, his tapes. If it sinks, Teal is a deserter forever.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Check the exit before the launch moves. Then stay until the patrol boat confirms the case has changed hands at sea.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: It doesn't sink.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: The launch is clear. Marines have the evidence. And the city still hears nothing but him.

transcript.speaker: RUSK
transcript.text: Citizens. Parliament has fled. Rebel aircraft are over the harbour. Stay inside. Trust the lights. Trust my voice.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: One tower, one voice, one emergency on repeat. He didn't build it to tell anyone anything. He built it so nothing else gets in.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: The broadcast relay sits in a block of apartments. He chose that too. The canal is the only dark line through the city.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Find the dish above the apartments before firing. Our repair crew is waiting in a launch to bring the district back afterwards.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: Everyone in those apartments has been listening to him for a year. I'd like to give them some quiet.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: The city heard silence last night. First time since spring. People opened their windows. Then the fog came in and he started fuelling.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: The reserve fuel has five piers. Each one has a civilian permit, and every permit has the same signature. He never learned a second name.

transcript.speaker: RUSK
transcript.text: Trainee. I knew Teal. He flew my wing the winter the coast starved while parliament debated. He had talent too. Ask the canyon how far it got him.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: That's the first time he's used his own name. He wants you to know he's a person. Don't let him.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: An inspection launch will follow you through the fog. Let its crew check the hoses, then show us the last two piers are dry.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: He flew your wing. Then you hunted him at night with your lights off. I'll remember both.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: His convoy can't refuel. Three loyalist frigates have ringed the offshore platform. The command frigate carries a green beacon and most of our hope.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: If I don't get home, leave the lane open for the next one. That's the job. There isn't a second part.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: The frigate captain was at his wing ceremony too. Half this coast was. Rusk forgot that we all remember.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Check the last gap and cover the inspection launch across it. The landing force is waiting for a ring we have actually checked.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: Green beacon. I'll stay close enough to read it.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: The frigate held. He's pulling his flag off the platform tonight and leaving his reserves on the deck. He's running, and he's leaving the fuel behind.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: Those stores were never on a defence map. You don't hide fuel at sea for a week. Only for a war.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Three stores on a trident of decks, under a storm he didn't order. There's no high approach left. Only the sea.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: A tanker is still on the platform, and workers are still on the deck. Stop the fuel leaving, then bring the rescue launch clear.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: He said the canyon got Teal. Let's see what the sea does to him.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: The platform is dry. Loyalist landing craft are off the city beach, waiting for first light. Parliament is coming home by boat.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: Don't fly for the people giving orders. Fly for the people who have to live beneath them. The man on the net is weather.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: He recorded that one at two in the morning. I can hear the hangar heater behind him. I could find that hangar in the dark by that sound.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Check both beach exits between the attacks. Stay on the landing channel until both squads answer from the streets.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: Beneath them. Right. The beach, then.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Recovery reached the upper pass this morning. They found his aircraft. They found him. He was in the seat. The recorder was still running.

transcript.speaker: RECORDER
transcript.text: RECORDER 7-T. ENTRY 04:12. PLAYBACK.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: Two taps. Sparrow, it's me. Lead is on my tail and I'm out of altitude, so I'm going to stay in the pass a while. The seed trucks need ten minutes.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: I flew that order knowing the price. The tapes are so you never have to take my word for any of it. This part I'm choosing myself.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: Fly the pattern too low and too fast. Nobody ever fixed it. Good. The sky will...

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: He bought those trucks ten minutes. Witnesses are boarding for parliament tonight. Keep their quay and launch safe so they can say what he did.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: I've amended the record myself. 'Aircraft lost with pilot. KILLED, NOT DESERTED.' Command can court-martial the paperwork.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: Ten minutes. He bought ten minutes. I'm going to go and spend them.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: The wing is broken. Your triangulation puts his last transmission above the parliament tower. He's alone up there with one relay and his own voice.

transcript.speaker: RUSK
transcript.text: Trainee. Land, and I'll tell the city you were misled by a dead man. Fly, and you're the traitor in every history I write.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: When you have the truth, send it in your own voice. You don't have to sound like me. You never did.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: I've got every harbour on the net. Every loyalist station is listening for one call sign. Not his. Yours.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Mark a clear road for Rusk before the duel. Then climb Teal's beacon line and stay on the air until every harbor hears you.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: Marshal. I heard the tape. He didn't sound misled. He sounded like he was counting trucks.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: Sera. Varda trainee, checking in. One of three. The other two are for after.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: He's down. His relay is dark. Every harbour on the coast is answering. You're on every receiver from the rim to the sea. Say it your way.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: This is Varda trainee, transmitting in the clear. The Air Marshal is down. The emergency is over. It never started.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: The orders were forged. The names were dead men's. An orchard was burned for a seed tin. Teal flew the pass so the trucks could get out.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: His name was Teal. He was not a deserter. Amend your records. For Teal. For the rim. We are coming home.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Varda trainee, Varda Control. Check-in received. Two of three. Come home and make the third in person.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: ...the sky will still be there.

transcript.speaker: LOG
transcript.text: VARDA RIM ROSTER. TEAL: KILLED IN ACTION, NOT DESERTED. INSTRUCTOR'S CHAIR: FILLED.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Turn, then pitch. Three seconds each. Feel how she answers.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Cycle targets. Mark the practice radar.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Nose on it. Hold the lock. Then fire.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Good hit. Three bandits inbound. Keep them off the field.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Three bandits over the harbor. Take them.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Five warehouses feed the raid. Burn them all.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Their lead is armored. Make every shot count.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: TEAL (tape): Stay low on the switchback.
